test_xp_assert_equal: test array equality across different array namespaces with dtype and shape checks
test_xp_assert_close: test array closeness with relative and absolute tolerances for floating point comparisons
test_xp_assert_less: test elementwise less-than comparison between two arrays with shape and dtype validation
create_as_numpy_array: convert arrays from various namespaces (CuPy, JAX, PyTorch, sparse) to NumPy arrays
test_xfail: mark a pytest test as expected failure while allowing the rest of the test to execute
